controles.affirmation: Depuis le 15 janvier 2025, la FTC et les procureurs generaux de cinq Etats (Illinois, Minnesota, Arizona, Michigan, Wisconsin) poursuivent Deere pour monopolisation et concurrence deloyale ; injonction permanente demandee
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "On January 15, 2025, the Federal Trade Commission (FTC), along with the Attorneys General of the States of Illinois and Minnesota filed a lawsuit against us... The Attorneys General of the States of Arizona, Michigan, and Wisconsin joined the lawsuit. The lawsuit alleges monopolization and unfair competition in violation of the federal and state antitrust laws. Plaintiffs seek a permanent injunction and other equitable relief"

controles.affirmation: Deere ecrit noir sur blanc etre incapable d'estimer l'impact potentiel sur son activite
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "At this stage, we are unable to estimate the potential impact on our business."

controles.affirmation: Au 28 mai 2026 aucune decision n'est rendue
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026, Item 1 Legal Proceedings : "On March 17, 2025, we filed a motion to dismiss the lawsuit... A hearing was held on the motion to dismiss and the court denied the motion."
controles.correction_proposee: Aucune decision sur le fond n'est rendue, mais le tribunal a rejete la requete en irrecevabilite de Deere, ce qui laisse l'affaire se poursuivre.

controles.affirmation: L'impact direct des droits de douane a ete d'environ 600 M$ en 2025 ; 372 M$ sur le S1 2026, net d'un remboursement de 272 M$, contre environ 95 M$ au S1 2025 ; ~80% des ventes domestiques assemblees aux Etats-Unis
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "The direct impact of these incremental tariffs incurred was $372 in the first six months of 2026, net of the tariff recovery described below, and approximately $95 in the first six months of 2025" ; "we prepared and filed a refund claim in the amount of $272, which has been accepted by the CBP". 10-K FY2025 : "In 2025, the direct impact of incremental tariffs incurred by us was approximately $600" ; "Nearly 80% of our domestic sales are assembled in the U.S."

controles.affirmation: La charge brute est donc d'environ 644 M$ en six mois, contre environ 95 M$ sur la meme periode de 2025
controles.verbatim_source: Le 10-Q ne publie aucun montant brut. Il indique seulement 372 M$ nets et un remboursement de 272 M$ obtenu apres l'invalidation IEEPA du 20 fevrier 2026, portant sur des droits payes anterieurement (les droits IEEPA courent depuis 2025).
controles.correction_proposee: Retirer le chiffre de 644 M$ ou ecrire : la charge de 372 M$ est nette d'un remboursement exceptionnel de 272 M$ portant sur des droits payes depuis 2025 ; le montant brut du seul semestre n'est pas publie.

controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025, Selected Financial Data : 5,027 / 7,100 / 10,166 ; 38,917 / 44,759 / 55,565 ; 73,146 / 75,847 / 82,956 ; Return on net sales 12.9% / 15.9% / 18.3%. Communique du 21 mai 2026 : "Net income attributable to Deere & Company for fiscal 2026 is forecasted to be in a range of $4.5 billion to $5.0 billion"

controles.affirmation: 63 822 M$ d'emprunts au 3 mai 2026 et ratio dette sur fonds propres de 8,7 pour 1 chez John Deere Financial ; 49 283 M$ de creances de financement
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026, bilan : Short-term borrowings 15,632 + Short-term securitization borrowings 5,929 + Long-term borrowings 42,261 = 63,822. "8.7 to 1" ; financing receivables end of period balance 49,283.

controles.affirmation: Marche du gros materiel agricole US/Canada en baisse de 15 a 20% en 2026, Amerique du Sud ~-15% ; "we cannot reasonably foresee when these conditions may subside"
controles.verbatim_source: Communique du 21 mai 2026 : "Large Ag ... Down 15 to 20%" ; "South America (Tractors & Combines) ... Down ~15%". 10-Q T2 2026 : "Changes in the agricultural market business cycle and global trade policies are driven by factors outside of our control, and as a result, we cannot reasonably foresee when these conditions may subside."
